newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - March 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - March 18.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5650. Fax: (822) 727-5666.
- North Korea has stopped its food distribution six months ago, according to a Korean resident in Japan who recently visited Pyongyang.
- Hanbo Group Chairman Chung Tae-soo gave money to about 20 politicians, according to an unnamed prosecution source.
- Hanbo probe expanding as banks and government officials face questioning this week.
